korean_canonical: 멜 센시르 전투(Battle of Mel Senshir)
korean_variants: 멜 센시르(Mel Senshir) 전투|멜 센시르(Mel Senshir) 전투(Battle of Mel Senshir)|멜 센시르 전투
notes: English identifies the named Battle of Mel Senshir, distinct from the city Mel Senshir. Japanese メル・センシアの戦い and Chinese 梅尔森溪之战 corroborate the historical event. Use the complete label 멜 센시르 전투(Battle of Mel Senshir), avoiding nested city and event annotations. The official Korean manual has no direct entry for this battle name.
